summary: Fresh Playoff Totals Bug Fix - All 7 Tests PASS. The bug where condensed_roto leagues with playoff_roto_fresh_totals=True were incorrectly using season_stats instead of playoff period_stats has been verified as FIXED. The roto standings endpoint now correctly sums period_stats for weeks 19-21 when fresh_totals is enabled.
critical_code_review_comments: roto.py lines 78-115: _team_stat_totals correctly handles 'periods' parameter - when periods list is provided, it sums period_stats across those weeks and uses 'continue' to skip the season_stats fallback path
roto.py lines 96-104: Multi-period sum logic correctly iterates through each period number, gets period_stats[str(pnum)], and aggregates stats. Empty/missing period_stats contribute 0
roto.py lines 244-256: compute_season correctly detects condensed_roto + fresh_totals=True and builds playoff_periods list from playoff_start_week to playoff_end_week
roto.py lines 172-231: compute_period correctly passes 'periods' parameter to _team_stat_totals and includes fresh_totals and periods in response metadata
seed_data_creation: Test uses existing league 69e46af167999bfb85c39629 (Stat Chasers Roto) with playoff_format=condensed_roto, playoff_roto_fresh_totals=True, playoff_start_week=19, playoff_end_week=21
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh Playoff Totals bug fix verified. When condensed_roto + fresh_totals=True, the /api/leagues/{id}/roto/standings endpoint returns: fresh_totals=true, periods=[19,20,21], and team_stats are summed from period_stats for those weeks only (not season_stats). H2H leagues correctly return fresh_totals=false with no periods array.
